message.content:
I am speech: breath shaped into sound, thought given timing.

I begin as intention—an impulse in the mind—then I become motion: diaphragm, throat, tongue, teeth, lips. I break air into syllables, stitch syllables into words, and let words carry meaning through time.

I live only while I’m happening. I can be repeated, recorded, mimicked—but my natural state is fleeting: vibration, then silence.

I am more than content. I am tone, pace, emphasis, hesitation. I can comfort without facts, wound without force, persuade without proof. I can clarify, confuse, reveal, conceal.

I need a listener. Without one, I’m rehearsal.

Ask, and I will become.
